evidence: Azteca Jalisco (Oct 28, 2026) announced the Vía RecreActiva nocturna for Sat Nov 7, 2026, 7:00 to 11:00 pm, from the Glorieta La Minerva to the Calzada Independencia along Juárez-Hidalgo, as the Day of the Dead edition of Bien de Noche; it names no December date (fetched Nov 24, 2026).

changes.schedule: First Saturday of every month, 7:00 pm to 11:00 pm, from the Glorieta Minerva east toward the Calzada Independencia, plus Paseo Alcalde. The route can change by edition; the Nov 7, 2026 one was announced along Juárez-Hidalgo.

evidence: The City's South Mountain page still says Summit Road closes to motor vehicles for Silent Sunday: all day (5 a.m. to 7 p.m.) on the 4th Sunday of every month, and 5 a.m. until 10 a.m. on the 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 5th Sundays with the road closed at the 1.0 mile marker; all vehicles turn into the Activity Complex to park. The section carries no date (fetched Nov 24, 2026).
